fatal_errors: The proposed Al-Li alloy is unrelated to the target MgAlTiVFeCo BCC alloy.
The composition adjustment and solution-aging treatment do not reconstruct SPS at 1000 °C.
The hypothesis omits the target oxide barrier phases, densification mechanism, passive-film behavior, and parabolic oxidation kinetics.
It provides no evidence supporting the specific 4 wt% Li composition or heat-treatment schedule.
The claimed simultaneous improvement in toughness and corrosion resistance at high lithium content is not established and may conflict with known tradeoffs.
explanation: The response addresses the broad goal of a lightweight material with multiple desirable properties, but otherwise misses the target material, processing route, testing conditions, mechanism, quantitative outcomes, and operating boundaries. Its comparative experiment could test its own Al-Li proposal, although the corrosion environment and statistical criteria are insufficiently specified. With no cited evidence and unsupported quantitative processing choices, it is not a defensible alternative to the target conclusion that SPS-processed MgAlTiVFeCo at 1000 °C gives the best comprehensive performance.
